prompt_en: An unmistakably adult bookish woman in her mid-twenties stands with her back against the sun-warmed white wall of a beachside pavilion, holding a weathered paperback against her chest. An unmistakably adult athletic blond man in his late twenties, deeply suntanned, wears an open coral resort shirt over a white tank and plants one palm on the wall beside her head and leans into a confident one-arm wall pin, directing the gesture toward her. The scene reads as a charged beachside confrontation between contrasting adult personalities. His cocky half-smile slips into a briefly intent, unmistakably attracted gaze as the paperback tilts between them. He keeps his braced hand beside the same woman; her startled composure cracks into a flushed, involuntary glance toward him, and the paperback lowers slightly between them. An intimate medium two-shot keeps both adult faces, his braced hand, and the paperback in one crisp relational plane while turquoise surf and beach grass soften behind them. Low golden sunlight rims his blond hair and bounces from the white wall across her face, balancing warm skin against cool water. Cinematic editorial photography, 50mm lens, natural skin texture, believable hands, shallow depth of field.
